abstract: Two cases of yolk sac tumor of the testis are presented. The patients were 17 months and 24 months old. The children were inflicted with painless swelling of their left scrotal content. alpha-Fetoprotein levels were elevated at presentation but decreased within normal limits after orchiectomy. Chest X-rays and CT scans were negative. The cases were diagnosed as stage I. Fifty six cases of testicular yolk sac tumor in children have been reported in Japan since 1981. There were no recurrent stage I cases. One patient with stage II and 3 patients with stage III died despite chemotherapy, while three children with stage II or stage III disease survived more than 36 months after a positive response to chemotherapy. We conclude that prepubertal stage I yolk sac tumor is treated best initially by orchiectomy alone. Aggressive chemotherapy has a major role in salvage of stage II or stage III patients.
abstract_ja: 精巣卵黄嚢腫瘍の2症例を報告する。患者は17か月と24か月の小児であった。小児は左陰嚢内容の無痛性腫脹を呈した。αフェトプロテイン(AFP)値は初診時に上昇していたが、精巣摘除術後に正常範囲内まで低下した。胸部X線検査およびコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)は陰性であった。両例とも病期I と診断された。1981年以降、日本では小児の精巣卵黄嚢腫瘍が56例報告されている。病期I の再発例はなかった。病期II の1例と病期III の3例が化学療法にもかかわらず死亡し、病期II または病期III の3例は化学療法に良好な反応を示した後、36か月以上生存した。我々は、思春期前の病期I の卵黄嚢腫瘍は、初期治療として精巣摘除術単独で最もよく治療されると結論する。病期II または病期III の患者の救済には、積極的な化学療法が大きな役割を果たす。
